messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets.
Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Use the medicine exactly as directed.
Take empagliflozin once a day in the morning, with or without food.
Your blood sugar will need to be checked often.
You may also need to test the level of ketones in your urine.
Empagliflozin can cause life-threatening ketoacidosis (too much acid in the blood).
Contact your doctor if a urine test shows that you have high ketones in the urine.
Even if your blood sugar is normal.
Blood sugar can be affected by stress, illness, surgery, exercise, alcohol use, or skipping meals.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia) can make you feel very hungry, dizzy, irritable, or shaky.
To quickly treat hypoglycemia, eat or drink hard candy, crackers, raisins, fruit juice, or non-diet soda.
Your doctor may prescribe glucagon injection in case of severe hypoglycemia.
You may get dehydrated during prolonged illness.
Call your doctor if you are sick with vomiting or diarrhea.
Triples: [["empagliflozin", "has administration instruction", "take once a day in the morning, with or without food"], ["empagliflozin", "has administration instruction", "follow all directions on prescription label"], ["empagliflozin", "has administration instruction", "read all medication guides or instruction sheets"], ["empagliflozin", "has administration instruction", "use exactly as directed"], ["empagliflozin", "has recommended dose", "dose may be occasionally changed by doctor"], ["empagliflozin", "has monitoring instruction", "check blood sugar often"], ["empagliflozin", "has monitoring instruction", "test ketone levels in urine"], ["empagliflozin", "has serious side effect", "life-threatening ketoacidosis"], ["empagliflozin", "has administration instruction", "contact doctor if urine test shows high ketones"], ["empagliflozin", "has administration instruction", "even if blood sugar is normal"], ["empagliflozin", "has warning", "blood sugar can be affected by stress, illness, surgery, exercise, alcohol use, or skipping meals"], ["empagliflozin", "has side effect", "low blood sugar (hypoglycemia)"], ["hypoglycemia", "has symptom", "very hungry"], ["hypoglycemia", "has symptom", "dizzy"], ["hypoglycemia", "has symptom", "irritable"], ["hypoglycemia", "has symptom", "shaky"], ["hypoglycemia", "has treatment", "eat or drink hard candy, crackers, raisins, fruit juice, or non-diet soda"], ["empagliflozin", "has treatment for severe side effect", "glucagon injection"], ["empagliflozin", "has warning", "may cause dehydration during prolonged illness"], ["empagliflozin", "has administration instruction", "call doctor if sick with vomiting or diarrhea"]]
Relations: ["has administration instruction", "has monitoring instruction", "has recommended dose", "has serious side effect", "has side effect", "has symptom", "has treatment", "has treatment for severe side effect", "has warning"]
Answer:

completion:
has administration instruction: The subject drug should be administered according to the specific instructions provided by the object entity.  
has monitoring instruction: The subject drug requires the patient to perform the monitoring activity specified by the object entity.  
has recommended dose: The subject drug may have its dose adjusted according to the guidance specified by the object entity.  
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.  
has side effect: The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity.  
has symptom: The medical condition specified by the subject entity is associated with the symptom described by the object entity.  
has treatment: The medical condition specified by the subject entity can be treated with the intervention specified by the object entity.  
has treatment for severe side effect: The subject drug has a specific treatment available for the severe side effect described by the object entity.  
has warning: The subject drug has a caution or warning related to the condition or factor specified by the object entity.
